papers.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
papers.abstract: Abstract Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/IDM.

ru.title: Точная отрисовка деталей за считанные шаги благодаря контролю моментов распределения
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM) — метод улучшения few-step генерации изображений по тексту. Он дополняет Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) явными ограничениями на моменты: средние признаков и покоординатные стандартные отклонения. Эти статистики берутся из EMA-копии генератора, поэтому внешний энкодер признаков (например, DINOv2) не нужен. Эксперименты на Z-Image-Turbo 6B и Qwen-Image 20B показывают лучшие результаты при двух вычислительных шагах на LongText-Bench, особенно при рендеринге длинных текстов.

en.title: Enhancing Text-to-Image Generation with Intrinsic Distribution Matching
en.desc: This paper presents Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), a method that enhances few-step text-to-image generation by applying moment constraints to distribution matching distillation (DMD). IDM aims to improve the accuracy of generated images by aligning the statistical properties of the generated distribution with a reference distribution, specifically focusing on feature means and standard deviations. The approach utilizes the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) to achieve this without needing an external feature encoder. Experimental results demonstrate that IDM achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-text rendering tasks with fewer network evaluations, outperforming existing methods.

zh.title: 内在分布匹配：提升文本到图像生成的利器
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为内在分布匹配（IDM）的方法，旨在改善少步文本到图像生成的效果。通过在分布匹配蒸馏中添加显式的矩约束，IDM能够在有限的网络评估中实现最佳的长文本渲染。该方法利用生成器的指数移动平均（EMA）副本来匹配特征均值和每个坐标的标准差，从而避免了使用外部特征编码器。实验结果表明，IDM在中文和英文的长文本基准测试中达到了最高的得分，显示出其在文本到图像生成中的有效性。

papers.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Abstract A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: training dynamics determine when to acquire new experience, while the answers to new tasks remain independently checkable. A-RSI monitors reward variation and accuracy in training logs to refresh a task pool when its learning signal declines, without consulting validation or test scores. A static library of model-authored programs produces multimodal questions and derives their reference answers; we specify the task-generation contract, automatically verify chosen properties of the reward and refresh rules, and separately audit the generated answers. The training loop uses no external training examples or human-written answer labels. On the primary eleven-benchmark suite, A-RSI raises the performance average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks.

Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Учиться дальше, когда старые задачи перестают работать
ru.desc: В статье представлен метод A-RSI, который улучшает рекурсивное самосовершенствование моделей машинного обучения. Система отслеживает вариативность наград и точность в логах обучения и обновляет пул задач, когда обучающий сигнал падает, не обращаясь к валидационным или тестовым метрикам. Новые мультимодальные вопросы и эталонные ответы генерируются статичной библиотекой программ, созданных самой моделью, а ответы проверяются независимо. На наборе из одиннадцати бенчмарков средняя точность выросла с 57,77 до 61,05 при использовании 800 новых задач, без внешних размеченных данных.

en.title: Revitalizing Learning: A-RSI Boosts Performance with Smart Task Refreshing
en.desc: A-RSI enhances recursive self-improvement in machine learning by introducing new training tasks when learning signals decrease. It focuses on determining the right time to refresh training experiences rather than just generating new experiences. The method uses independently verifiable answers generated by programs, eliminating reliance on uncertain model predictions. As a result, A-RSI significantly improves benchmark performance without needing external labels, achieving a notable increase in average scores across multiple tasks.

zh.title: 提升学习性能的自我改进方法
zh.desc: A-RSI通过根据学习信号的下降来刷新训练任务，从而改进递归自我改进。它使用独立可验证的程序生成答案，提升了基准性能，而无需外部标签。该方法关注何时引入新经验，并通过监控奖励变化和训练日志中的准确性来刷新任务池。最终，A-RSI在主要的十一项基准测试中，将性能平均值从57.77提高到61.05，使用了800个新任务。

papers.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
papers.abstract: Abstract This work formalizes benchmark evaluation through difficulty measures, identifies failure modes of measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and proposes diagnostic metrics and a rewriting algorithm to improve benchmark coverage.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverage gaps.

ru.title: Бенчмарк должен честно измерять всю шкалу сложности, а не только её часть
ru.desc: Статья рассматривает бенчмарки для оценки моделей не просто как набор тестовых вопросов, а как эмпирическое распределение по сложности задач. Авторы выделяют два ключевых сбоя: несоответствие распределения сложности (measure mismatch) и пробелы в покрытии (coverage gaps), из-за которых бенчмарк не замечает локальный прогресс обучения. Предложены две диагностические метрики с теоретическими гарантиями, а также эмпирический анализ 25 популярных бенчмарков из 7 областей с оценкой сложности каждого элемента. Наконец, представлен BenchFill, простой алгоритм переписывания вопросов, нацеленный на сложность, который эффективно сокращает локальные пробелы в покрытии.

en.title: Enhancing Benchmark Evaluation with Difficulty Measures
en.desc: This paper focuses on improving how we evaluate machine learning benchmarks by introducing difficulty measures. It identifies two main problems: measure mismatch, where the benchmark's difficulty does not match what was intended, and coverage gaps, where certain difficulty levels are not tested at all. The authors propose new diagnostic metrics to detect these issues and analyze 25 popular benchmarks to show that many do not accurately reflect model performance across all difficulty levels. To address these gaps, they introduce BenchFill, an algorithm that rewrites benchmark items to ensure better coverage of the difficulty spectrum.

zh.title: 提升基准评估的覆盖性与准确性
zh.desc: 本文通过难度度量形式化基准评估，识别了度量不匹配和覆盖缺口的失败模式，并提出了诊断指标和重写算法以改善基准覆盖。基准不仅仅是测试问题的集合，它自然引入了难度的经验度量。我们开发了基于度量的基准评估视角，识别并形式化了两个主要的失败模式：度量不匹配和覆盖缺口。最后，我们提出了BenchFill算法，有效减少了局部覆盖缺口。

papers.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs under key-value caching for further efficiency gains. Code and project page are available at https://hyeon9698.github.io/LOWN/

ru.title: Смотрим на картинку только тогда, когда это действительно нужно
ru.desc: Диффузионные vision-language модели (DVLM) на каждом шаге денойзинга обрабатывают всё входное изображение, хотя визуальные токены составляют до 89–97% входа, что делает декодирование очень затратным. Авторы показали, что удаление изображения меняет предсказание лишь примерно в 22,8% шагов, поэтому картинку нужно пересчитывать не всегда. Метод LOWN на каждом шаге сначала предсказывает маскированные токены без изображения и обращается к картинке только при расхождении с предыдущим предсказанием, а согласованные токены переиспользует и демаскирует. Без дополнительного обучения и подбора порогов метод сохраняет 99,6% качества LLaDA-V при использовании около 35% FLOPs на декодирование.

en.title: Efficient Image Processing with Adaptive Decoding in DVLMs
en.desc: The paper introduces LOWN, a novel decoding method for diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) that optimizes computation by adaptively skipping image processing when predictions are consistent. By analyzing the necessity of visual tokens during decoding, LOWN determines when to process the image based on prediction agreement, significantly reducing redundant computations. This method retains high accuracy while achieving a 35.3% reduction in decoding FLOPs, demonstrating its efficiency across various benchmarks. LOWN also shows compatibility with existing visual token pruning techniques and enhances performance without requiring additional training or tuning.

zh.title: LOWN：智能跳过图像处理的解码方法
zh.desc: LOWN是一种自适应解码方法，用于在扩散视觉语言模型中跳过图像处理，从而减少计算量并保持准确性。通过比较预测结果，LOWN决定在每个解码步骤中是否处理图像，以及解锁多少个视觉标记。研究表明，图像在大多数步骤中并不是必需的，因此LOWN能够有效地重用之前的预测。最终，LOWN在多个基准测试中保持了高达99.6%的准确率，同时将解码计算量减少了35.3%。

papers.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
papers.abstract: Abstract Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--good views--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. Second, we show that next-token prediction is a JEPA with bad views, parts of a single document, which explains why language models align with vision only through scale. Third, we validate the theory from 145k captions to the texts of 940M web images, and uncover a scaling law of alignment that predicts unseen runs within seed noise. Good views need 42 times fewer training samples than next-token prediction on the same corpus to reach the same alignment, and a 109M-parameter text JEPA aligns with DINOv2 and CLIP's image encoders better than every language model we evaluated, up to 72B parameters, and than CLIP's text encoder: next-token prediction is a remarkably inefficient route to platonic representations. As a showcase, one rotation turns separately trained encoders into an image captioner (CIDEr .838 on COCO). Even that rotation needs no pair: on the latest pair-free benchmark, our text JEPA beats every zero-shot accuracy reported with language models up to 8B parameters, e.g., 64\% against at most 56\% top-5 on ImageNet-100. Positive views, and not scale alone, are thus the lever to build platonic representations.

papers.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
papers.abstract: Abstract Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordinate system, and a few fusion layers let video frames attend to concurrent audio, bringing cross-modal fusion and temporal alignment into perception itself. OmniSchema unifies the outputs of all ten parsing tasks, allowing a single self-evolving post-training procedure, OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation (OSAD), to provide a shared token-role-based objective across tasks. In each round, the model is trained on its own rollouts against token-level targets from a reference-conditioned copy of itself, which is then refreshed with the trained weights, so that the parser and its supervision co-evolve. With a single 5 B-parameter checkpoint, Youtu-Parsing-Omni achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.96 Overall) and leads all open-weight models on OmniParsingBench (75.08 Avg.), with its advantage concentrated on audio and video. It also achieves the best overall chart-parsing score (95.02) and the highest exact chemical-fingerprint agreement among compared systems, and matches a dedicated optical-music model in character-level transcription of typeset sheet music while staying far ahead of general-purpose systems. Code and model weights are publicly available.

papers.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
papers.abstract: Abstract L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to 38.6times fewer 3D primitives, 3.2times faster memory updates, and 359times faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

ru.title: Согласованные миры в реальном времени благодаря компактной 3D-памяти
ru.desc: Статья представляет L3G-World — интерактивную модель мира, которая генерирует видео по действиям пользователя и сохраняет пространственную согласованность при долгом исследовании сцены. Ключевая идея — компактная латентная память из 3D-гауссиан (Latent 3D Gaussian Memory), где каждый гауссиан хранит VAE-признаки и рендерится напрямую в латентное пространство DiT без повторного кодирования VAE. Память-апдейтер и video diffusion transformer работают в авторегрессионном чередовании: память растёт с размером сцены, а не с длиной потока. По результатам экспериментов модель достигает state-of-the-art качества, использует до 38.6 раз меньше 3D-примитивов и обеспечивает генерацию в реальном времени на уровне 9 FPS.

en.title: Real-Time Interactive Worlds with Efficient 3D Memory
en.desc: L3G-World introduces a novel approach to generating interactive 3D environments using a compact Latent 3D Gaussian Memory. This method allows for real-time generation of spatially consistent worlds by alternating between a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer. Unlike traditional methods that struggle with memory scaling, L3G-World efficiently grows memory based on scene extent rather than the length of generated content. The results demonstrate significant improvements in generation quality and speed, achieving real-time performance while maintaining long-horizon spatial consistency.

zh.title: 实时生成空间一致的互动世界
zh.desc: L3G-World是一种利用紧凑的潜在3D高斯记忆和交替自回归更新的技术，能够实时生成空间一致的互动世界。该方法通过结合前馈重建的高效性和快速可渲染的场景表示，解决了在长时间探索中保持空间一致性的挑战。与现有方法相比，L3G-World的记忆更新器在新观察区域生成高斯分布，并优化现有的高斯分布，使得记忆的增长与场景范围相关，而不是生成流的长度。实验表明，L3G-World在生成质量和空间一致性方面达到了最先进的水平，显著提高了生成速度和效率。

papers.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
papers.abstract: Abstract WorkFactory builds coherent professional tasks via information planning and repair, yielding WorkPilot models that improve expert-level agent performance across benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. All three models improve over their respective base models across four professional-work benchmarks, with WorkPilot-35B-A3B improving from 879 to 1565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. Scaling analyses reveal model-dependent diminishing returns, with execution length first increasing and then decreasing. Controlled component analyses show that planning and repair reduce probe-diagnosed task environment defects and improve downstream performance. The data and models are available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/WorkFactory.
affiliations: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

ru.title: Качественные задачи — основа умных AI-агентов
ru.desc: В статье представлен WorkFactory — масштабируемый фреймворк для автоматического создания согласованных и исполнимых профессиональных задач, которые используются для supervised fine-tuning LLM-агентов. Сначала строится information support graph, отражающий зависимости и источники необходимой информации, затем probe-запуски выявляют дефекты и запускают процедуру repair. На основе 112 686 задач из 612 профессий получены траектории учителя, которыми дообучены модели Qwen на 4B, 27B и 35B-A3B, образовавшие семейство WorkPilot. Все модели превосходят базовые на четырёх бенчмарках профессиональной работы, например WorkPilot-35B-A3B повышает Elo на GDPval-AA v2.1 с 879 до 1565.

en.title: Building Better Tasks for Smarter Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces WorkFactory, a framework designed to create coherent professional tasks through information planning and repair. It addresses the challenge of inconsistent task information that can hinder the performance of supervised learning agents. By constructing an information support graph, WorkFactory helps in organizing the dependencies and necessary information for executing tasks effectively. The resulting WorkPilot models demonstrate significant improvements in agent performance across various benchmarks, showcasing the effectiveness of this approach in enhancing supervised training for professional tasks.

zh.title: 构建一致专业任务，提升智能代理表现
zh.desc: WorkFactory 是一个构建一致专业任务的框架，通过信息规划和修复来提升专家级代理的表现。该框架从专业意图出发，构建信息支持图，以指导任务的实例化，明确表示所需信息的依赖关系和位置。通过探测执行，识别支持失败并指导修复，同时保持预期的工作目标。我们构建了 112,686 个任务，涵盖 612 个职业，并利用收集到的教师轨迹对 Qwen 模型进行微调，显著提升了模型在专业工作基准测试中的表现。

papers.title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
papers.abstract: Abstract Retrieval heads remain sparse and shared across audio-visual modalities, and optimizing them improves document retrieval performance in multimodal models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. In this paper, we ask whether this mechanism expands together with the input modalities of the model. Taking audio-visual input as a newly added modality, we construct paired inputs in which the same answer is either spoken or shown on screen. With the evidence content fixed, retrieval heads remain sparse in the new modality and are shared to a large extent across modalities. Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones. Ablating these heads eliminates nearly all audio-visual retrieval. The heads shared across modalities make up fewer than 2\% of all heads, yet ablating them also degrades document understanding, spatial perception, and visual mathematics. Building on these findings, we turn retrieval heads into a target of optimization by training their attention with a ranking objective. This raises the page Recall@1 of Qwen3-VL-8B on MMDocIR by 6.03 points and improves document retrieval across three model families. Functional attention heads can thus serve both as a lens on multimodal models and as a target for improving them.

School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Retrieval heads: от инструмента анализа к цели оптимизации мультимодальных моделей
ru.desc: Статья исследует «retrieval heads» — редкие attention heads, которые переносят релевантную информацию из длинного контекста в ответ Multimodal LLM. Авторы добавляют аудио-визуальную модальность и показывают, что эти головы остаются разреженными и в основном общими для разных модальностей, а у omni-modal моделей сохраняются из backbone. Абляция этих голов почти полностью убирает аудио-визуальный retrieval и ухудшает понимание документов, пространственное восприятие и визуальную математику. Обучение attention таких голов с ranking objective повышает Recall@1 Qwen3-VL-8B на MMDocIR на 6.03 пункта и улучшает document retrieval у трёх семейств моделей.

en.title: Optimizing Retrieval Heads for Enhanced Multimodal Document Retrieval
en.desc: This paper investigates the role of retrieval heads in multimodal large language models, particularly focusing on audio-visual inputs. Retrieval heads are specialized attention mechanisms that help the model locate relevant information from long inputs. The study finds that these heads remain sparse and are shared across different modalities, which is crucial for effective document retrieval. By optimizing these retrieval heads, the authors demonstrate significant improvements in retrieval performance across various model families.

zh.title: 优化检索头，提升多模态模型性能
zh.desc: 本文探讨了在多模态大语言模型中，检索头的优化如何提升文档检索性能。研究发现，尽管检索头在不同模态间共享且数量稀少，但它们对音频-视觉检索至关重要。通过对检索头进行优化，作者成功提高了模型在文档检索任务中的表现。最终，研究表明，功能性检索头不仅可以帮助理解多模态模型，还可以作为提升模型性能的目标。

papers.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

ru.title: Детали без лишней глобальной связи: больше разрешения, та же цена
ru.desc: В статье представлен SpecSlot — pixel-space трансформер для генерации изображений на основе rectified flow, который повышает детализацию без роста вычислительных затрат. Ключевая идея: низкочастотная структура требует глобального взаимодействия через attention, а высокочастотные детали можно моделировать локально. Каждый пространственный якорь разбивается на несколько слотов, каждый из которых отвечает за свою полосу DCT-коэффициентов, и только самый низкочастотный слот участвует в глобальном attention. На ImageNet-256 и ImageNet-512 SpecSlot сопоставим или превосходит контрольную модель JiT по FID при меньшем количестве FLOPs, а в задаче text-to-image также показывает лучший результат на DPG-Bench.

en.title: Enhancing Image Detail Efficiently with SpecSlot
en.desc: SpecSlot is a novel approach that enhances pixel-space generative Transformers by utilizing localized spectral slots and limiting global attention, which helps to improve image detail without increasing computational costs. Traditional methods require more tokens for finer details, leading to higher expenses in global attention. SpecSlot innovatively separates the modeling of low-frequency structures, which benefit from global communication, from high-frequency details that can be captured locally. This method allows for greater spectral detail while maintaining efficiency, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks like ImageNet and DPG-Bench.

zh.title: SpecSlot：提升图像细节的高效生成模型
zh.desc: SpecSlot是一种改进像素空间生成Transformer的方法，它通过使用局部谱槽和限制全局注意力来提高图像细节，同时不增加计算成本。传统的生成Transformer通常每个图像块使用一个token，捕捉更细致的细节需要更多的token，这使得全局注意力变得更加昂贵。研究表明，细节并不一定需要更多的全局通信：低频结构受益于全局交换，而高频细节可以在局部建模。SpecSlot通过将每个空间锚点扩展为多个槽，并仅让最低频率的槽参与全局注意力，从而实现了细节与全局注意力序列长度的解耦。

papers.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. Under a shared agentic harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints passes an average of 69.9% of criteria per task but fully satisfies only 26.4% of tasks. All ten endpoints achieve lower criterion completion on repository edits spanning three or four change types than on those spanning one or two. Co-Design Bench provides a testbed for studying the gap between partial requirement satisfaction and complete task success under agentic execution for real-user application revisions.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: От частичного успеха к полной готовности: разрыв в AI-агентах для со-дизайна
ru.desc: В статье представлен Co-Design Bench — новый бенчмарк для оценки того, насколько AI-агенты для написания кода способны превращать мультимодальные запросы реальных пользователей (текст, изображения, аудио, видео, документы) в работающие правки приложений. Набор включает 273 задачи из почти 26 тысяч реальных сессий и делится на два трека: локальное редактирование (Multimodal Editing) и согласованные изменения в репозитории (Repository Editing). Оценка проводится без эталонного кода: 2 331 скрытый критерий приёмки проверяется протоколом judge-then-refute, где положительные вердикты оспаривает отдельный LLM-верификатор. Результаты показывают, что лучшая из десяти моделей выполняет в среднем 69.9% критериев, но полностью решает лишь 26.4% задач, что выявляет разрыв между частичным и полным успехом агентного выполнения.

en.title: Bridging the Gap in Human-AI Co-Design
en.desc: This paper presents Co-Design Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate how well coding agents can understand and execute user requests that involve multiple types of inputs, such as text, images, and audio. It consists of 273 tasks derived from real user coding sessions, focusing on two main areas: making localized edits and revising entire code repositories. The benchmark assesses agents based on their ability to understand user requests, transform user interfaces, and implement functional changes, using a rigorous grading system that includes expert criteria and verification by a language model. The results show that while the best-performing model meets a significant portion of the criteria, it struggles with more complex tasks that require multiple changes, highlighting the challenges in achieving complete task success in human-AI collaboration.

zh.title: 人机协作设计的新基准测试
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一个名为Co-Design Bench的基准测试工具，用于评估人类与人工智能共同设计的能力。该基准包含273个任务，来源于真实用户的编码会话，涵盖多模态编辑和代码库编辑。任务涉及三个能力维度：基础理解、用户界面转换和功能实现。研究结果显示，尽管模型在任务中表现出一定的能力，但在满足所有要求方面仍存在显著差距。

papers.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
papers.abstract: Abstract VibeGame is a framework that uses specialized adversarial agents and an AI-native engine to build complete 2D games from natural-language prompts with interactive validation and self-evolving reusable components.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language model agents have enabled software development through natural-language interaction, but extending this paradigm to end-to-end game development remains challenging. Building a playable game requires coordinating code, scenes, assets, animations, physics, and configurations, while allowing developers to validate their integrated behavior through interactive testing. We introduce VibeGame, a framework for creating complete 2D game projects from natural-language prompts and optional reference images. Its AI-native game engine represents project state as schema-validated structured text and provides frame-synchronous runtime control, enabling agents to inspect game states, execute actions, and verify behavior at their own pace. Built upon this interface, we design an Adversarial Agent Team of eight specialized agents to separate implementation from review, so that problems are found and fixed through multi-round loops. For each conducted and accepted project, we further introduce a training-free self-evolution mechanism to distill it into reusable skeletons, modules, and collaboration contracts for future development. We evaluate prompt-assets-to-game (PA2G), where agents are given an asset library, and prompt-to-game (P2G), where agents generate their own art. On a GameCraft-Bench subset, VibeGame in P2G consistently outperforms a range of agent harnesses in either P2G or PA2G with the same underlying model, including GPT-6.1-Sol.

ru.title: Игра из одной фразы: агенты, которые создают, проверяют и учатся
ru.desc: В статье представлен VibeGame — фреймворк, который с помощью LLM-агентов создаёт полноценные 2D-игры по текстовому описанию и опциональным референсным изображениям. Ключевая особенность — AI-native движок, который хранит состояние проекта в виде структурированного текста с валидацией по схеме и даёт агентам покадровое управление рантаймом для проверки поведения. Команда из восьми специализированных агентов разделяет роли реализации и ревью, находя и исправляя ошибки в многораундовых циклах. Дополнительно реализован механизм самоэволюции без обучения, который извлекает из принятых проектов переиспользуемые скелеты, модули и контракты взаимодействия, а на бенчмарке GameCraft-Bench VibeGame в режиме P2G превосходит другие агентные системы на той же базовой модели.

en.title: Transforming Game Development with AI and Natural Language
en.desc: VibeGame is a novel framework designed for creating complete 2D games using natural language prompts. It employs specialized adversarial agents to manage the complexities of game development, such as coordinating code, assets, and animations, while allowing for interactive validation. The framework features an AI-native engine that maintains project state as structured text, enabling agents to inspect and control game behavior dynamically. Additionally, VibeGame introduces a self-evolution mechanism that allows successful projects to be distilled into reusable components for future development.

zh.title: 用自然语言构建完整2D游戏的创新框架
zh.desc: VibeGame是一个框架，利用专门的对抗代理和AI原生引擎，从自然语言提示中构建完整的2D游戏。这个框架解决了游戏开发中的复杂性，包括代码、场景、资产、动画、物理和配置的协调。通过交互式测试，开发者可以验证集成行为，确保游戏的可玩性。VibeGame还引入了一种自我进化机制，将项目提炼为可重用的骨架和模块，以便于未来的开发。

papers.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
papers.abstract: Abstract HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Причёска целиком: быстрее и точнее через диффузию над множеством карточек
ru.desc: HairDeck — это метод, который по одному изображению генерирует стилизованные hair cards (ленты волос) и spring-bone цепочки для их анимации. В отличие от CHARM, который декодирует причёску авторегрессивно как длинную последовательность control points, HairDeck рассматривает причёску как неупорядоченное множество карточек, где каждая карточка представлена одним токеном. Все карточки одновременно денойзит set diffusion transformer, что повышает точность и ускоряет генерацию примерно в 33 раза. Результатом становится готовый к анимации ассет, который экспортируется в стандартные форматы для игр и аватаров.

en.title: Revolutionizing Stylized Hair Generation with HairDeck
en.desc: HairDeck is a novel approach that generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations using a diffusion transformer, which enhances both accuracy and processing speed compared to previous techniques. Unlike traditional methods that create realistic hair or single meshes, HairDeck treats hair cards as unordered sets of tokens, allowing for more efficient generation. By denoising all hair cards simultaneously, it produces animatable assets directly from a single image. The results show significant improvements in accuracy metrics and processing time, making HairDeck a powerful tool for creating stylized character hair in games and avatars.

zh.title: HairDeck：高效生成风格化头发的创新方法
zh.desc: HairDeck 是一种生成风格化头发卡片和弹簧骨动画的方法，使用扩散变换器来提高准确性和速度。与现有的图像基础方法不同，HairDeck 将头发卡片视为无序的艺术家定义的原始元素，并将其作为一个整体生成。每个头发卡片被视为一个单独的标记，集成的扩散变换器可以同时去噪所有卡片。通过从单张图像生成头发卡片和驱动它们的弹簧骨链，HairDeck 提供了可动画的资产，并在性能上显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
papers.abstract: Abstract WeVisCut is a script-to-video system that trains a compact policy to coordinate video editing tools, recover from failures, and reduce token usage while maintaining quality.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.

ru.title: Компактный агент монтажа: качество Opus при в 33 раза меньшем расходе токенов
ru.desc: В статье представлен WeVisCut — система для создания длинных видео по сценарию, которая управляет инструментами монтажа через компактную политику, обученную с помощью LLM-агента. Авторы строят четырехэтапный пайплайн данных, который восстанавливает намерения монтажа из готовых видео (editing inversion) и проверяет их через replay, получая более 130 тысяч обучающих примеров из 3750 видео. На этих данных обучается единая 9B-модель, которая координирует производство и восстанавливается после ошибок в той же среде. Также вводятся бенчмарк из 100 задач и пять метрик качества монтажа и надежности доставки. WeVisCut значительно превосходит базовую модель, сопоставим с Claude Opus 5 при расходе токенов примерно в 33 раза меньше и лучше специализированных редакторов по предложенным метрикам.

en.title: Efficient Video Editing with WeVisCut: Quality Meets Compactness
en.desc: WeVisCut is a novel script-to-video system that optimizes video editing by training a compact policy to effectively manage editing tools and recover from errors. It utilizes a four-stage data pipeline that combines editing inversion and verified replay to create a robust training dataset from finished videos. By maintaining a shared production state, WeVisCut ensures that feedback from editing tools informs future decisions, enhancing the coherence and quality of the final output. The system demonstrates significant improvements in efficiency and performance, achieving high-quality results with substantially fewer resources compared to existing models.

zh.title: WeVisCut：高效的视频编辑新方法
zh.desc: WeVisCut 是一个脚本到视频的系统，旨在通过训练紧凑的策略来协调视频编辑工具，恢复故障并减少令牌使用，同时保持视频质量。该系统通过连接工具执行与策略学习，解决了现有多阶段工作流程中质量与成本之间的权衡问题。WeVisCut 的代理维护共享的生产状态，使得工具反馈能够影响后续决策和修复。经过对 3750 个完成视频的应用，该系统生成了超过 13 万个训练示例，并在编辑质量和交付可靠性方面显著优于基础模型。

papers.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract IntReal introduces a real-world interleaved multimodal dataset and evaluation framework to diagnose unified model strengths and improve generation through targeted training.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored. Progress in this area is hindered by two key limitations: (1) the lack of well-defined interleaved generation tasks and corresponding training data, and (2) the absence of fine-grained evaluation protocols that can reliably diagnose model performance across different capability dimensions. To this end, we present IntReal, comprising two complementary components: IntReal-100K, a real-world dataset of multimodal interleaved samples spanning four major categories, and the IntReal Evaluation Suite, which evaluates model performance across seven complementary dimensions using specialized expert models, enabling coarse-to-fine diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate our evaluation suite through low inter-metric redundancy (max pairwise absolute Spearman's ρleq 0.42 ), high agreement with human judgments (83.3% accuracy), and strong consistency across different expert evaluators (Spearman's ρ> 0.9 ), supporting the complementarity and reliability of our metrics. By benchmarking four families of UMMs, we show that IntReal Evaluation Suite reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses across models. Post-training experiments demonstrate the utility of IntReal-100K for improving interleaved generation and further show that training unimodal generation can also benefit interleaved generation. These findings suggest that interleaved generation can benefit from modality-specific optimization, rather than requiring joint text-image training at every stage.

ru.title: Чередующаяся мультимодальная генерация выигрывает от оптимизации под каждую модальность
ru.desc: Статья представляет IntReal — набор из двух компонентов для работы с чередующейся мультимодальной генерацией текста и изображений: датасет IntReal-100K из 100 тысяч реальных примеров и систему оценки IntReal Evaluation Suite. Оценка включает семь взаимодополняющих метрик, которые используют специализированные экспертные модели, и показывает низкую избыточность, высокое согласие с человеческими оценками (83.3%) и устойчивость между разными экспертами. Эксперименты на четырёх семействах Unified Multimodal Models выявили сильные и слабые стороны моделей, а дообучение на IntReal-100K улучшило генерацию. Авторы также показали, что обучение только генерации одной модальности может улучшить чередующуюся генерацию.

en.title: Enhancing Multimodal Generation with IntReal
en.desc: The paper introduces IntReal, a new dataset and evaluation framework designed to enhance the performance of Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) in generating interleaved text and images. It addresses the challenges of limited training data and evaluation methods for multimodal interleaved generation tasks. IntReal consists of a dataset with 100,000 real-world samples and an evaluation suite that assesses model performance across multiple dimensions. The findings indicate that targeted training can improve interleaved generation, suggesting that optimizing for specific modalities can be more effective than joint training.

zh.title: 交错生成的未来：优化多模态模型
zh.desc: IntReal是一个用于诊断统一模型优缺点的真实世界交错多模态数据集和评估框架。该框架通过针对性训练来改善生成效果，特别是在文本和视觉信息交错生成方面。研究表明，现有的统一多模态模型（UMMs）在这一领域的进展受到缺乏明确任务和训练数据的限制。IntReal包含两个部分：一个包含多模态交错样本的数据集和一个评估套件，能够在多个维度上评估模型性能，帮助识别模型的强项和弱项。

papers.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.abstract: Abstract CoSTA decouples generation and synthesis token spaces to accelerate spoken dialogue models while preserving quality and compatibility.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling. To address this limitation, we propose CoSTA, a compatibility-preserving post-hoc framework that decouples generation and synthesis token spaces while retaining the original speech tokenizer and decoder. CoSTA extends the generation token space with compressed representations via mean-initialized vocabulary extension, pronunciation adaptation, and dialogue adaptation, followed by deterministic expansion back to the original speech-token space before synthesis. On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately 1.7times expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput while preserving response quality. Analyses show more sustained interaction under limited budgets and a practical trade-off among compression, decoding efficiency, and quality. Further experiments demonstrate cross-architecture transfer and complementarity to low-rate tokenization.
